version.description: Increment this when the config changes. Used to check if a config needs updating.

modId.description: The ID of the mod this config belongs to. The generated config mod becomes an optional dependency of this mod.

loaderId.description: Ignored. Configs are now installed as mods, so they no longer need a mod loader ID.

file.description: Name of the file to download in the 'configs' folder for this game in this db.
